title: Progressions
description: This plugin adds progressions to your server
body:
🎮 Progressions Plugin

📋 Overview

A server progression system that gradually unlocks gameplay features over time, creating structured and exciting gameplay for survival servers and SMP communities!

✨ Core Features

🎯 4-Stage Progression System

Progression 1 🌱 - Restricted starter phase (XP Level Up sound 🔊)

Progression 2 🔥 - Unlocks after 10 days (Portal sound 🌀)

Progression 3 ⚔️ - Advanced stage (Smithing Table sound ⚒️)

Finale 🐉 - Manual trigger (Dragon Roar 🗣️)

🚫 Restriction System

Dimension Control 🌍

✅ Block/Allow Nether & End access per progression

✅ Prevent portal usage and teleportation

✅ Fully configurable for each stage

Enchantment Restrictions ✨

✅ Block Protection IV & Sharpness V

✅ Prevents enchanting table & anvil combinations

✅ Blocks enchanted book creation

Item Restrictions 💎

✅ Block netherite crafting & smithing upgrades

✅ Prevents netherite armor, tools, ingots & blocks

✅ Configurable per progression

💬 Commands

/progression start - Start the system 🚀

/progression set <1-3> - Manually set progression 🎚️

/progression finale - Open The End 🎆

/progression stop - Stop the system 🛑

/progression status - Check status & stats 📊

/progression reload - Reload config 🔄

Permissions 🔐

progressions.start, progressions.set, progressions.finale, progressions.stop, progressions.status, progressions.reload

🎨 Customization

Visual 👁️

✅ Custom titles, subtitles & chat messages

✅ Configurable timings (fade-in, stay, fade-out)

✅ Full color & formatting support

Audio 🔊

✅ Custom sounds for each progression

✅ Adjustable volume & pitch

✅ Enable/disable individually

Timing ⏱️

✅ Configure days until each progression

✅ Adjustable check intervals

✅ Based on in-game time(20 min = 1 day)

🎯 Default Timeline

Stage 1 (Days 0-9) 🌱

❌ Nether, End, Protection IV, Sharpness V, Netherite

Stage 2 (Days 10-19) 🔥

✅ Nether, Protection IV, Sharpness V

❌ End, Netherite

Stage 3 (Day 20+) ⚔️

✅ Netherite

❌ End

Finale (Manual) 🐉

✅ Everything unlocked!
